name: The Mark of Quality
summary: At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider seeks ten thick yeti hides and will not compromise on quality.

sections.title: A Matter of Pride
sections.body: Jangdor Swiftstrider takes pride in fine leatherwork. He has found thick yeti hides in Feralas, where the yetis make their home. Many roam west of Camp Mojache in Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.

sections.title: The Offer
sections.body: Bring Jangdor a stack of ten hides at Camp Mojache. In return, he will let you choose one of the leather goods he has made.

sections.title: Jangdor's Thoughts on the Hides
sections.body: Jangdor says special treatment can make the hides hold up as well as iron. Finding the right tanning mix will take many attempts. He believes these hides can raise his mark of quality higher than before.

faq.q: Who is asking for the hides?
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider, the leatherworker at Camp Mojache in Feralas, is asking for the hides.

faq.q: Where can the yetis be found?
faq.answer: Yetis make their home in Feralas. Many roam west of Camp Mojache in Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.
Ten hides, brought in one stack.

faq.q: What do I get for the hides?
faq.answer: Jangdor offers you a choice of the leather goods he has made in exchange for the stack.
